ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the highest in the food chain in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram is titled “Food Chain.” It shows sunlight reaching phytoplankton on the right, then arrows showing energy moving from phytoplankton to zooplankton, to small fish, to mackerel, to mahi mahi, and finally to a large shark at the bottom right. Then reason: In a food chain, the organism at the final end of the energy-flow arrows is the highest trophic level. Since the arrows end at the large shark, the highest in the food chain is the large shark.
